Name: 6_fog_weather_the_sf
Representative_Docs: ["Even in its most serene moments, SF's fog has a presence that feels almost magical. This morning, GoldenGate Bridge looked like the backdrop to a fairytale scene as mist enveloped it from all sides. The tranquil effect of the fog makes people want to pause and appreciate the beauty around them more than usual.", "SF's infamous fog has arrived again, wrapping GoldenGate Bridge in mist that looks like it could be from another movie 🌁. Misty conditions make for some seriously Instagram-worthy photos and videos, but they also mean driving can get tricky. Bundle up with a good winter coat and gloves while KarlTheFog sends out his daily updates on the fog's progress. Weather forecasters advise keeping an eye on this one, as it could linger through Tuesday.", "SF weather can be so unpredictable that it’s not uncommon to experience fog one day and sunshine the next. Always expect the unexpected when it comes to San Francisco's weather."]
